# Per-fixture benign-delta allowlist for the e2e-fidelity-compare-fmt gate.
#
# Format: one symbol name per line; lines starting with `#` and
# blank lines are ignored. Each entry pre-empts impactful
# classification — use sparingly and only for symbols where
# operator triage confirmed the diff is structural / toolchain-
# origin and not a converter bug.
#
# fmt 11.0.2 (close-gaps campaign rollout): 146/146 exported
# symbols match. The three entries below are C++ template
# instantiations that exist on one side but not the other — the
# cmake distro toolchain and Bazel's hermetic toolchain make
# different inlining / instantiation decisions at -O3 -DNDEBUG.
# The fidelity-compare prefix pairer (24-char shared mangled
# prefix) can't pair them because each has no counterpart on the
# other side. None of these are exposed in fmt's public API;
# they're internal detail-namespace helpers emitted at varying
# inlining depths across the two toolchains.

# fmt::v11::detail::utf8_decode — bazel-side instantiation
_ZN3fmt3v116detail11utf8_decodeEPKcPjPi
# fmt::v11::detail::parse_dynamic_spec — bazel-side instantiation
_ZN3fmt3v116detail18parse_dynamic_specIcEEPKT_S5_S5_RiRNS1_7arg_refIS3_EERNS0_26basic_format_parse_contextIS3_EE
# fmt::v11::detail::format_float<double> inner lambda — cmake-side instantiation
_ZZN3fmt3v116detail12format_floatIdEEiT_iNS1_11float_specsERNS1_6bufferIcEEENKUljPcE_clEjS8_

# fmt::v11::detail::dragonbox::cache_accessor<double>::get_cached_power(int)
# — bazel-side weak template instantiation, same different-inlining-decision
# category as the three above. Surfaced once the converter started faithfully
# applying fmt's CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET=hidden /
# CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN presets to the Bazel build as raw copts
# (PR #395). Previously those flags were lifted onto visibility_* features no
# toolchain backs, so the fidelity bazel build — which uses bazel's default
# autodetected toolchain — silently dropped them and compiled fmt *without*
# visibility hiding. Now -fvisibility=hidden -fvisibility-inlines-hidden reach
# the compile (matching cmake), which shifts gcc/clang's template-instantiation
# / inlining boundary: this dragonbox cache accessor for double is emitted as a
# standalone weak symbol bazel-side where the cmake distro toolchain doesn't
# emit it (inlined away / instantiated at a different boundary). It's a
# detail-namespace internal helper, not part of fmt's public API.
_ZN3fmt3v116detail9dragonbox14cache_accessorIdE16get_cached_powerEi
